what: The hero stays pinned while the next section (a filled panel) slides up over it, and the covered hero dims from brightness 1 to .2 over one screen of scroll, tied directly to scroll with no curve

options.amount: Amount of darkening (0~1), default .8 — end brightness = 1 − amount
options.distance: Scroll distance until fully dark (multiple of screen height), default 1

note: The cover sticks with position: sticky, so the parent must be a panel wrapping both the hero and the following body (body·main). Give the following panel a background color and z-index so it appears to cover.

from.where: index.html .sp-cover (cover hero) — original Lay cover: cover_darken_when_scrolling, brightness = map(scrollY, 0, innerHeight, 1, 1 − .8)
